experiment.baseline: CURRENT v54 at blob ec3d2dd63a02b233e0fb0d17e40f60ede25a6184 with projection digest ad48fd1f042f5e68830acb632c0dd75060753c81b31d84d138e74bc2f9550474; C14 pointer_update_pattern 2/4; prior event digest 93c3b401d7d7ef6d95365af58e28132fe76716ed3db4275895776c932e64ccde.
experiment.controlled_factor: Pointer materialization only: remove the exact prior-CURRENT pointer field from mutable CURRENT while retaining one exact latest-event anchor. Recover the prior CURRENT pointer and predecessor event transitively from the immutable latest event source_binding.
experiment.exact_probe: Create and read back the immutable v54-to-v55 event. Re-fetch CURRENT after the event commit and require exact v54/blob/projection digest. Replace CURRENT using only the exact v54 blob SHA. The v55 manifest must bind the v55 event exactly, omit expected_previous_pointer, and document that prior-pointer and predecessor resolution require fetching and verifying the v55 event source_binding. Re-fetch CURRENT and the v55 event and verify that source_binding names exact v54 CURRENT and v54 predecessor event.
experiment.hypothesis: A head-event-only mutable manifest minimizes duplicated anchors while preserving deterministic reconstruction because the immutable head event binds both the exact prior CURRENT and predecessor event. The tradeoff is that every backward step requires an event read and compatible source_binding schema.
experiment.strongest_falsifier: The idempotency key already exists; event bytes fail digest recomputation; the second CURRENT read differs from exact v54/blob/projection digest; GitHub rejects or incorrectly accepts a stale blob SHA; final CURRENT retains a duplicated prior-pointer field or misbinds the v55 event; the v55 event fails to identify exact v54 CURRENT and v54 predecessor event; or head-event-only traversal is ambiguous.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This wake tests one pointer projection through GitHub's Contents API. Removing the prior-pointer anchor makes CURRENT smaller but less self-describing: reconstruction now depends entirely on fetching the immutable head event and on source_binding schema continuity. A missing, corrupt, or schema-incompatible head event blocks backward traversal even if CURRENT itself is readable. Git stores every commit, so this is not repository storage compaction. The event and CURRENT remain separate commits, and Slack follows both. GitHub's per-file blob-SHA precondition is not a database compare-and-swap transaction and provides no cross-file atomicity, serializable isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, lock fairness, Slack atomicity, or automatic orphan repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the immutable event or Slack message. If the head-event-only manifest is later rejected, append a compensating event from the then-current version and replace CURRENT only with that pointer file's exact then-current blob SHA. Restore an exact prior-pointer anchor by rehydrating it from the verified immutable head event source_binding.
